meta.title: Wakefulness Soft | Software built with clear thinking
meta.description: Wakefulness Soft designs and develops web applications, mobile apps, and tailored software solutions for real business needs.

footer.brandDescription: Clear thinking for useful software — with a little midnight focus and a lot less noise.

bottom.madeWith: Made with ☕ and focused lines of code.

hero.description: Wakefulness Soft designs and develops web applications, mobile apps, and tailored digital solutions that turn complex needs into clear, useful experiences.
hero.slogan: Clear thinking for useful digital products.

services.headline: Our main services.
services.intro: We transform your ideas into clear, functional and sustainable digital solutions, accompanying you from the definition of the strategy and technical scope to the development, implementation and evolution of the software that your business needs.
services.scopeNote: These service areas are conversation starters, not a promise that every capability fits every project. Scope, technical needs, and delivery constraints are confirmed before work begins.

web.name: Web application development
web.description: Browser-based tools, portals, and business applications shaped around real workflows.
web.need: When spreadsheets, disconnected tools, or manual steps make everyday work harder than it should be.
web.benefit: A focused experience that brings essential information and actions into one place.

mobile.name: Mobile application development
mobile.description: Mobile product experiences planned around the people, context, and tasks they need to support.
mobile.need: When customers or teams need a reliable way to complete key tasks away from a desktop.
mobile.benefit: A clearer path from a mobile use case to a product people can navigate with confidence.

consulting.name: Technical consulting
consulting.description: Structured guidance to clarify a software idea, improvement, or technical decision before committing to a build.
consulting.need: When the problem is understood but the right scope, priorities, or path forward is still uncertain.
consulting.benefit: Better-informed decisions and fewer assumptions before time and budget are committed.

support.name: Software maintenance & support
support.description: Focused work on existing software, from planned improvements to ongoing maintenance within an agreed scope.
support.need: When a current product needs attention, clearer priorities, or a practical plan for its next stage.
support.benefit: Software that can keep serving the business while change is handled deliberately.

hero.headline: Thoughtful software, without the fog.
hero.description: We help turn a business need into a clear software direction. The work begins with people, workflows, constraints, and the definition of success — so technology supports the goal instead of obscuring it.

lines.init: Define the problem before choosing the solution
lines.quality: Structure work so it is easier to understand and evolve
lines.speed: Focus effort on the priorities that matter most
lines.transparency: Explain decisions and trade-offs in plain language
lines.innovation: Choose technology for fit, not for novelty

whySection.headline: Clear principles. Practical benefits.
whySection.paragraph1: Good software starts with an understood problem and deliberate choices.
whySection.paragraph2: We aim for every product and technology decision to have a clear purpose and a real impact.

pillars.title: Craftsmanship Over Shortcuts
pillars.content: We look beyond the quickest answer and consider what the software needs to support over time.
pillars.benefit: A solution shaped around lasting usefulness instead of short-lived convenience.

pillars.title: Human Perspectives
pillars.content: Business context and user needs stay visible when product and technical decisions are discussed.
pillars.benefit: Stakeholders can understand the direction and make better-informed choices.

pillars.title: Strong Foundations
pillars.content: Structure and future change are considered while the solution is being defined, not only after complexity appears.
pillars.benefit: A clearer base for the next useful improvement.

pillars.title: Performance by Design
pillars.content: Performance needs are discussed in the context of real users, devices, data, and constraints.
pillars.benefit: Attention goes to the interactions where responsiveness matters most.

pillars.title: Quality in Every Detail
pillars.content: Expected behavior and important edge cases are made visible before a feature is considered ready.
pillars.benefit: Fewer surprises between the agreed need and the delivered experience.

pillars.title: Reliable Delivery
pillars.content: Priorities, decisions, and progress are kept understandable throughout the engagement.
pillars.benefit: A clearer view of what is being worked on and why.

processSection.headline: A focused path from need to software.
processSection.body: We move forward progressively, reducing uncertainty at each stage to transform a need into clear decisions and, ultimately, into useful software.

1.description: Discuss the problem, the people affected, the current workflow, and what a useful outcome would look like.

2.description: Turn the need into priorities, boundaries, assumptions, and an agreed first version of the work.

3.description: Map the experience and technical direction needed for the agreed scope, including the decisions that still require validation.

4.description: Implement the agreed priorities in understandable increments so feedback can arrive while it is still useful.

5.description: Review behavior against the agreed goals, user flows, and acceptance criteria using the validation methods chosen for the project.

6.description: Prepare the agreed handoff or release and identify the next improvements without turning every idea into immediate scope.

projects.headline: Purpose-built solutions.
projects.sub: Projects that show how we approach problems, make decisions, and build software that serves a specific purpose.
projects.verificationNote: Nebula Platform, Phantom API, Drift UI, and Hollow CLI are presented as concept placeholders. They are not identified as client projects, production systems, or proof of results.

status.concept: concept — not a client case study

nebula.objective: Explore how a team could bring distributed work, permissions, and operational visibility into one experience.
nebula.direction: A dashboard-led product direction whose workflows and data requirements still need validation.
nebula.capability: Illustrates product modeling and information-heavy interface thinking; delivery evidence is pending owner review.

phantom-api.objective: Explore a dependable interface between systems with clearly defined access and usage expectations.
phantom-api.direction: An API design exercise; architecture, performance targets, and implementation technology are intentionally unclaimed.
phantom-api.capability: Illustrates API scoping and integration thinking; delivery evidence is pending owner review.

drift-ui.objective: Explore a consistent set of interface patterns for a dark, product-focused experience.
drift-ui.direction: A reusable visual language concept whose component coverage and validation still need definition.
drift-ui.capability: Illustrates component and interaction design thinking; delivery evidence is pending owner review.

hollow-cli.objective: Explore how repeatable project tasks could be made clearer through a command-line workflow.
hollow-cli.direction: A tooling concept whose supported environments, safeguards, and implementation remain to be specified.
hollow-cli.capability: Illustrates workflow automation thinking; delivery evidence is pending owner review.
